snippet.title: Mystery Case Files: The Riddle of Mrs. Bishop Game Trailer
snippet.description:
GrandMA Studios presents the first case in a new era for the Master Detective with Mystery Case Files: The Riddle of Mrs. Bishop!

Get ready to take up the iconic badge once again when a disoriented, rambling stranger visits the agency asking for the Master Detective, kicking off an investigation into the unbelievable story of Mrs. Agnes Bishop. What initially seems like a case of mild confusion takes an alarming turn when the visitor mumbles a name that should be long forgotten in this timeline. Soon, the Master Detective is hot on the trail in a case of family jealousy, secrets, and identities… but who’s really in control? Face down a dangerous new enemy and survive deadly traps as you explore every corner of the Bishop family’s mansion in a case that could threaten everything you thought you knew about the Master Detective’s past! Jump in for an unforgettable new chapter in the classic Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure series!

Available now!

PC: https://www.bigfishgames.com/us/en/games/18903/mystery-case-files-riddle-of-mrs-bishop-ce/?pc&lang=en

Mac: https://www.bigfishgames.com/us/en/games/18903/mystery-case-files-riddle-of-mrs-bishop-ce/?mac&lang=en
